Most CVs show only what worked. For every fellowship, paper or job listed on mine, most applications quietly didn't, and those rarely appear anywhere. This page lists them.

The idea comes from Melanie Stefan, who suggested in *Nature* that scientists keep a "CV of failures" ([Stefan, 2010](https://doi.org/10.1038/nj7322-467a)). I share mine because rejection is a routine part of research, and seeing it written down may help anyone, especially students and early-career researchers, who wonders whether it happens to everyone. It does.
